comments.author: Sapphire Eye
comments.body_html: Howdy, any chance for the Death on total health reaching 0 to be its own standalone feature? The closest mod i’ve seen to that before wouldn’t let you actually die

comments.author: Landonk89
comments.body_html:
Here is a quick build of only that functionality, I don’t have the ability to test it at the moment since my SPT bugged out until I can reinstall it, but it should work as expected :)

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZPAXwB21HhJLfp6d-2zBFhPY5l3BflNS/view?usp=sharing

And the source if interested:

using EFT;
using EFT.HealthSystem;
using HarmonyLib;
using SPT.Reflection.Patching;
using System.Reflection;
using BepInEx;

namespace StayAliveUntilZero;

[BepInPlugin("com.landonk89.StayAliveUntilZero", "StayAliveUntilZero", MyPluginInfo.PLUGIN_VERSION)]
public class Plugin : BaseUnityPlugin
{
    private void Awake()
    {
        Logger.LogInfo("Plugin StayAliveUntilZero is loaded!");
        new PlayerKillPatch().Enable();
    }
}

internal class PlayerKillPatch : ModulePatch
{
	protected override MethodBase GetTargetMethod()
	{
		return AccessTools.Method(typeof(ActiveHealthController), nameof(ActiveHealthController.Kill));
	}

	[PatchPrefix]
	private static bool Prefix(ref ActiveHealthController __instance)
	{
		if (__instance.Player != GamePlayerOwner.MyPlayer)
			return true; // If this health controller is not our player, act normally

		// Disallow death until health is actually zero
		if (__instance.GetBodyPartHealth(EBodyPart.Common).Current > 0f)
			return false;
		else
			return true;
	}
}
